name: STOP-Bang Questionnaire

citations.text: Chung F, Yegneswaran B, Liao P, et al. STOP questionnaire: a tool to screen patients for obstructive sleep apnea. Anesthesiology. 2008;108(5):812-821.

validated_population: Adult surgical patients at preoperative clinics; later validated in sleep clinic and general populations.
license_note: STOP-Bang is copyrighted by the University Health Network (Toronto). Terms of use are published at stopbang.ca; verify permission before production deployment.

red_flags.question: Have you fallen asleep while driving, or nearly caused a crash from sleepiness, in the past month?
red_flags.help: Drowsy driving is dangerous. Do not drive until you have been evaluated.

items.question: Do you snore loudly (louder than talking, or loud enough to be heard through a closed door)?
items.help: Ask a bed partner or family member if you are not sure.

items.question: Do you often feel tired, fatigued, or sleepy during the daytime?
items.help: For example, falling asleep while reading or watching TV.

items.question: Has anyone seen you stop breathing, or choke or gasp, during your sleep?
items.help: Ask a bed partner or family member.

items.question: Do you have, or are you being treated for, high blood pressure?
items.help: Answer yes if a clinician has told you that you have high blood pressure.

items.question: Is your body mass index (BMI) more than 35?
items.help: BMI 35 is about 205 lb at 5'4", 225 lb at 5'7", 245 lb at 5'10", or 265 lb at 6'1".

items.question: Is your neck size more than 16 inches (40 cm)?
items.help: Measure around the neck at the Adam's apple, or use your shirt collar size.

items.question: Is your sex assigned at birth male?
items.help: The questionnaire was validated using sex assigned at birth.

scoring.threshold_text: 0–2 low risk; 3–4 intermediate risk; 5–8 high risk of moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea.

low.label: Low risk of sleep apnea
low.interpretation: Your score suggests a low risk of moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea.
low.recommendation: No sleep testing needed based on this score.

care.within: No visit needed for this concern
care.where_detail: Home care. Book a primary care visit if daytime sleepiness continues.
ed_redirect: Fell asleep while driving: stop driving until evaluated
Chest pain or trouble breathing: call 911
self_care: Keep a regular sleep schedule of 7 or more hours.
Avoid alcohol within 3 hours of bedtime.

intermediate.label: Intermediate risk of sleep apnea
intermediate.interpretation: Your score suggests an intermediate risk of obstructive sleep apnea.
intermediate.recommendation: Book a primary care visit to discuss whether a sleep study is needed.

ed_redirect: Fell asleep while driving: stop driving until evaluated
Chest pain or trouble breathing: call 911

high.label: High risk of sleep apnea
high.interpretation: Your score suggests a high risk of moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea.
high.recommendation: A sleep study is advised. Book a primary care or sleep medicine visit.

care.where_detail: Primary care or a sleep medicine clinic.
ed_redirect: Fell asleep while driving: stop driving until evaluated
Chest pain or trouble breathing: call 911
